name: Lokalise - Register to_review Webhook in All Projects
description: One-time (re-runnable) helper: lists every Lokalise project, checks its existing webhooks, and registers the to_review n8n webhook for project.key.added + project.translation.updated wherever it is missing. Skips projects that already have it.

parameters.content:
## Setup helper - rollout control

Registers the to_review webhook in Lokalise projects. Safe to re-run: it reads each project's existing webhooks first and only creates what is missing.

**Rollout scope lives in the Find Missing Webhooks node**, in the ONLY_PROJECT_IDS array at the top.

- Right now it holds one ID: Realchecker (FE) - the pilot, already registered.
- **Empty the array (ONLY_PROJECT_IDS = []) and run again to roll out to all 39 projects.**

Subscribed events: project.key.added and project.translation.updated. Lokalise delivers the bulk variants under those same two subscriptions.

Read Registration Summary after each run for created / already-registered / failed counts.
